post_clip.description: A person in a striped shirt enters from the left holding a long, rigid object resembling a baton or pipe, walks purposefully toward the center while other pedestrians appear to notice and subtly shift away. The individual’s posture and the presence of the object suggest potential threat or intent to commit violence or intimidation; no uniformed officers are visible to indicate a lawful arrest, and the behavior deviates significantly from normal pedestrian conduct.

A person is lying on the floor in the center-left of the walkway across multiple frames (2803.5s–2809.5s), while several individuals—including at least one in dark attire resembling a uniform—gather around them. One individual appears to be kneeling or crouching beside the prone person, consistent with restraint or detention. No visible struggle or violence is ongoing, but the posture and grouping strongly suggest an arrest or medical intervention by security/police; given the task definition focusing on arrests and uniformed officers restraining someone, this qualifies as an anomalous event.
